description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Wait up to 45 seconds for the oldest queued change to your own game (including a remix). Claims one request for 5 minutes (studio_progress extends it to 30) and returns its DATA block and a 15-minute build.download pass. Download, change, test and stage that build, then call studio_done. Only the owner presses Ship on the site. Call again before progress to re-deliver the same pick with a fresh pass. At timeout returns {waiting:true}; call again.

game.description: Optional slug of your own game.

name: studio_wait
